title: IE49002: Instrumentation System Design
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Signal conditioning circuits: Design of bridge circuits and amplifiers for
strain gage and RTD; Cold junction compensation for thermocouple, Linearisation
of Thermistor characteristics, Signal conditioning for Piezoelectric sensors.
Design of obstruction type flow meter, diaphragm type differential pressure
transmitter and square root extractor. Design of control valve- flow-lift
characteristics and sizing. Design of Relay Ladder Diagram for a Sequential
Control System. Design of a Microprocessor based Instrumentation System, Design
of 4-20 mA transmitter, interfacing circuits and data acquisition system.
